title: When predictions are shown and for what scope
question: Should predictions be on by default, and only in ML-method projects? Should they cover zones or ignore them? How is the productivity effect of changed working conditions expressed?
context: The PRD wants predictions on by default with zones ignored; the code defaults them off, restricts them to ML-method projects with one stage, and computes zone predictions when asked (PROG-REQ-071, PROG-REQ-072, both disputed).
